en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional song about the beg Uso (Husein) of Timjanik, per the source note. Line 'дупето му нанино' I render literally as 'his mother's backside', a vulgar jeer in the refrain; my reading. The '(друга верзија)' marker is copied unchanged.

words_to_learn.en: he went (dialect, with ми as filler)

lines.en: Mother scolded Uso of Timjanik,
Uso of Timjanik, the Tsar of Negotino:

lines.cyr: - Ај послушај Усо старата си мајка,
lines.lat: - Aj poslušaj Uso starata si majka,
lines.en: - Come, Uso, listen to your old mother,

lines.cyr: немој, не ми оди на каурска свадба.
lines.lat: nemoj, ne mi odi na kaurska svadba.
lines.en: don't go, don't go to the infidel wedding.

lines.cyr: Не ми оди Усо на каурска свадба,
lines.lat: Ne mi odi Uso na kaurska svadba,
lines.en: Don't go, Uso, to the infidel wedding,

lines.cyr: каури се лоши, ќе се поднапијат.
lines.lat: kauri se loši, ḱe se podnapijat.
lines.en: the infidels are bad, they will get a bit drunk.

lines.cyr: Каури се лоши, ќе се поднапијат,
lines.lat: Kauri se loši, ḱe se podnapijat,
lines.en: The infidels are bad, they will get a bit drunk,

lines.cyr: ќе се поднапијат, ќе ми те убијат!
lines.lat: ḱe se podnapijat, ḱe mi te ubijat!
lines.en: they will get a bit drunk, they will kill you!

lines.cyr: Усо не послуша старата си мајка,
lines.lat: Uso ne posluša starata si majka,
lines.en: Uso did not listen to his old mother,

lines.cyr: па ми је отишол на каурска свадба.
lines.lat: pa mi je otišol na kaurska svadba.
lines.en: and he went to the infidel wedding.
The infidels, bad ones, got a bit drunk,

lines.cyr: ми се поднапиле, Усо го убиле!
lines.lat: mi se podnapile, Uso go ubile!
lines.en: they got a bit drunk, they killed Uso!

lines.cyr: Ду-ду, ду-ду, ду-ду дупето му нанино
lines.lat: Du-du, du-du, du-du dupeto mu nanino
lines.en: Du-du, du-du, du-du, his mother's backside

lines.cyr: на Усо тимјанички, на Царот неготински.
lines.lat: na Uso timjanički, na Carot negotinski.
lines.en: to Uso of Timjanik, to the Tsar of Negotino.

lines.cyr: Зошто не послушал старата си мајка,
lines.lat: Zošto ne poslušal starata si majka,
lines.en: Because he did not listen to his old mother,

lines.cyr: па ми е отишол на каурска свадба.
lines.lat: pa mi e otišol na kaurska svadba.
lines.en: and went to the infidel wedding.
Duru, duru, duru,
may God strike him down,
Uso of Timjanik,
the Tsar of Negotino.
- Come, son Uso,
don't go, my son,
to the infidel wedding.
The infidels are bad,
they will get a bit drunk,
they will kill you.
Uso did not listen to his mother,
he went to the infidel wedding,
a brawl began,
there and here, Uso,
he was nowhere to be found,
dudu-ro, duru, dudu-ro,
Uso's mother
wept for him sorrowfully:
- Why, son Uso,
did you not listen to your mother,
you went to the wedding
to lose your head.
